order: Execution Order: Revision of the Entry-State Indicator and Related Fixes (6 October 2026, revised the same day), section 7
status: REGISTERED - NOT RUN (waiting for the survivorship-free data: Sharadar/Norgate access pending receipt)

supersedes.reason: the order was revised the same day, before any run: the WAIT state removed (a passing trend gate is READY, extended or pulling back), short interest of 20% or more of the float added as a heavily-shorted trigger, and contestant (d), all overbought events, added. The superseded registration never ran and stays unedited; the version-2 configuration it pinned (sha 4aa58cc4) is kept byte-identical at data/entry_state_config_2026-10-06_v2.json

universe.source: point-in-time S&P 500 constituents from the purchased survivorship-free data (Sharadar or Norgate), delisted names included

events.spacing: per stock and per event type: a later trigger inside 20 sessions of the last counted event of the same type is skipped

outcomes.excess: stock total return minus SPY total return over the same sessions, net of costs
outcomes.drawdown_20: max(0, -(lowest close in sessions 1..20 / entry - 1)); the median is reported

contestants.a: the revised rules (version 3) at the event close, for each event type: (a1) oversold events and (a2) overbought events at which the version-3 machine reads READY or READY-HALF (trend gate not failed; no ceiling cap from yearly closing highs known at the time; modifiers at or above a quarter). heavily_shorted not applied (neither days-to-cover nor short interest of the float exists point-in-time); the earnings modifier applied only if the data carries report dates
contestants.b: the 2-October rules (version 1): from each oversold event, the first session within 10 sessions at which the version-1 machine reads READY (trend, setup, trigger); outcomes from that session's close

comparisons.primary: (a1)-(c): does the version-3 gate improve oversold entries
secondary: (a2)-(d): the same gate on overbought entries
(c)-(d): buying pullbacks against buying strength (the basis for removing WAIT)
subgroups_descriptive: overbought with positive 12-month momentum within 5% of the 52-week high

bootstrap.blocks: event months resampled with replacement; each drawn month brings all its events from every contestant and both event types

power_check.pair: (c) split at random into two halves by event, seed 20261006, same statistics and bootstrap
power_check.passes: every difference's 90 percent interval (five statistics, two horizons) includes zero
power_check.if_fails: the real comparison is descriptive only; a new registration is required

decision_rule.supported: power check passes AND the 90% interval of (a1)-(c) in mean 60-session excess lies entirely above zero AND the lower bound of (a1)-(c) in the worst 10% at 60 sessions is no worse than -0.010
decision_rule.wait_removal: the removal of WAIT stands unless the 90% interval of (c)-(d) in mean 60-session excess lies entirely above zero (pullbacks better than strength); then it is reported for the operator's decision
decision_rule.label: DIAGNOSTIC until this test reports; on 'supported' the operator decides whether to lift it; (b) decides nothing

expected_result: not supported: (a1)-(c) mean 60-session excess within plus or minus 1 point with an interval including zero; worst 10% similar; (c)-(d) within plus or minus 1 point with an interval including zero; median 20-session drawdowns within 1 point
seen_before_registration: the order's section 1 tables (about 80 large companies, 2011-2026: 4,540 oversold and 6,593 overbought events) and the 5-Oct states of LMT, MU, POWL, INCY, TPL and ONDS
do_not_touch: nothing above changes once a run begins; a change requires a new registration with a stated reason, and both results are reported
